item.title: NC AG files motion to continue illegal monopoly case against Live Nation after U.S. DOJ settlement
item.description: North Carolina Attorney General Jeff Jackson filed a motion to continue an antitrust case against Live Nation Monday after the United States Department of Justice announced a settlement the same day.

item.title: 1995 California homicide suspect arrested in Goldsboro, police say
item.description: A suspect wanted in a homicide in California from over 30 years ago was arrested in Goldsboro last week, police said.

item.title: Economists: Rising gas prices may affect the prices of other goods in Raleigh
item.description: Gas prices have seen a dramatic increase in the last week. Some economists warn this could translate to you paying not only more at the pump, but also at places like the grocery store.

item.title: Federal agency unsure if Poe Hall contamination caused cancer cases at NC State, report shows
item.description: A federal agency was unable to determine if cancer cases at North Carolina State University are connected to a contaminated building, a report shows.
